index.html.<!doctype html>: Tells the browser to read this file as modern HTML.
index.html.<html lang=\"en\">: Sets English as the page language for readers and assistive tools.
index.html.<meta charset=\"utf-8\">: Allows characters such as the arrow symbols to display correctly.
index.html.<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=: Makes the page use the device’s actual screen width.
index.html.<title>Classic Snake</title>: Names the browser tab Classic Snake.
index.html.<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"style.cs: Loads the colors and layout from style.css in this folder.
index.html.<script src=\"script.js\" defer></script: Loads the game logic after the browser has read the HTML.
index.html.<main>: Groups the game as the main content.
index.html.<header><strong>Snake</strong><output id: Shows the game name and gives JavaScript a place to display the score.
index.html.<canvas width=\"400\" height=\"400\" tab: Creates a 400-by-400 drawing surface that can receive keyboard focus.
index.html.<div class=\"controls\">: Groups the play button and steering arrows.
index.html.<button id=\"start\">Play</button>: Creates the button that starts a round. JavaScript finds it by its ID.
index.html.<button data-turn=\"ArrowLeft\" aria-lab: Sends the same left turn as the left arrow key.
index.html.<button data-turn=\"ArrowUp\" aria-label: Sends the same upward turn as the up arrow key.
index.html.<button data-turn=\"ArrowDown\" aria-lab: Sends the same downward turn as the down arrow key.
index.html.<button data-turn=\"ArrowRight\" aria-la: Sends the same right turn as the right arrow key.
index.html.<p id=\"status\" role=\"status\">Use arr: Shows instructions and lets screen readers announce game updates.
